note: Adapted from the original English description published with this species by Bacchus (1997); the alate, soldier and large worker are all described in prose, with measurement tables; the numbers and row labels of the large-worker measurement table are completely misplaced in the OCR, so only its prose morphology is cited and not its values. In the soldier measurement table the OCR gives head length including mandibles 1.25-1.40 and head length to mandible base 0.78-0.93, which agree with a head width of 0.69—0.78, so these are retained.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head orange-brown, with many yellow dots of unequal size scattered at the setal bases; postclypeus and labrum yellow; anteclypeus yellowish white; antennae yellow, brownish on both sides, segments 1 and 2 darker; pronotum yellow, distinctly paler than the head, with a white median longitudinal stripe. Body yellow, concolorous with the pronotum; tibiae and tarsi darker than the femora. Wings pale yellow, costal vein darker. Posterior margin of head capsule arcuate, evenly rounded; setae above and behind the compound eyes few, not extending beyond the eye bulge; frontal gland pore a small pore; central spot oval; only the trunk of the cranial suture visible; head surface slightly concave around the frontal gland pore; frons weakly wrinkled in front of the central spot. Postclypeus not a complete semicircle, median suture distinct. Compound eyes oval; ocelli short-oval, not touching the compound eyes. Labrum length less than width. Antennae 15-segmented, segments 3, 4 and 5 similar, segments 1 and 2 subequal. Pronotum with numerous setae, anterior and posterior margins moderately concave; posterior margins of meso- and metanota in a moderately deep V shape, median longitudinal line incomplete. Wings extending beyond the body, projecting a short distance past the abdomen.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and labrum pale yellow to pale orange; mandibles brown to reddish brown with yellow bases; antennae yellowish white to pale yellow; postmentum concolorous with the head, darker than the genae; thoracic nota, abdomen and legs yellowish white to yellow. Head capsule long-oval, sides slightly converging anteriorly, with a few setae; the pair of setae on the frons very close together; posterior margin slightly and evenly rounded. Labrum ligulate, with 4 pairs of setae on the anterior third. Mandible apex slightly incurved, curvature 0.03—0.04 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 similar and larger than segment 3, segments 1 and 2 subequal. Postmentum short and broad. Pronotum saddle-shaped, with few setae, anterior margin with a deep V-shaped notch, posterior margin slightly concave, corners rounded. Fore tibia slightly inflated; spurs 3, the dorsal spur well developed, almost as long as the outer ventral spur; the large seta on the fore coxa not spine-like.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule yellow to orange; mandibles brown with yellow bases; body, legs and antennae pale yellow; postclypeal pad yellow reddish brown. Head capsule subrectangular; sides almost parallel; posterior margin broadly and evenly rounded. Head setae numerous, regularly and symmetrically arranged; fork of the cranial suture present; postclypeus inflated, lenticular to very flat bean-shaped.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (11 heads, 8 colonies, mm): head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 1.10—1.20, head width including compound eyes 1.23—1.33, postclypeus length 0.30—0.33, width 0.58—0.63, labrum length 0.38—0.40, width 0.45—0.50, maximum diameter of compound eye 0.43—0.48, minimum diameter 0.36—0.40, maximum diameter of ocellus 0.15—0.18, minimum diameter 0.13—0.15, distance from ocellus to compound eye 0.03—0.04, pronotum length 0.83—0.93, width 1.13—1.27, hind tibia length 1.28—1.40. Soldier measurements (25 heads, 20 colonies): head length including mandibles 1.25—1.40, head length to mandible base 0.78—0.93, head width behind antennal sockets 0.65—0.70, maximum head width 0.69—0.78, labrum length 0.28—0.30, width 0.20—0.23, left mandible transverse length 0.48—0.53, width 0.04—0.06, curvature 0.03—0.04, fore tibia length 0.45—0.53, width 0.13, hind tibia length 0.50—0.60, width 0.08—0.10, maximum pronotum width 0.43—0.50, postmentum length 0.43—0.50, maximum width 0.32—0.38. Large-worker measurements (the numbers in the original table are severely misplaced in the OCR and are not cited).
